text:
Mikko: Anyone else get delayed by the Pier 7 crowd this morning? I queued for the 8:10 and we didn't leave until 8:50.
commute-bot: FERRY ALERT: Pier 7 heavy boarding volumes; expect 30-45m delays. Operators monitoring.
Rhea: I got on a later ferry and they handed out free hot chocolate? Kind strangers win the morning. :hot_beverage:
Owen: Wind on the bridge was a menace. Lost my transit hat to a gust near the lookout. If you find a navy beanie with an embroidered sailboat, please DM. :sos:
Harriet: FYI lower garage drain clogged by the east pillar, puddles forming. Security says avoid spots C4-C6.
Mikko: Thanks @Harriet. Also office kitchen now has a tiny "commute kit" box with disposable shoe covers & a roll of paper towels. Label says "take one if you're soaked".
Rhea: :raised_hands: grabbing a shoe cover at lunch. Also, heads up: 8X bus delayed near 3rd St. according to the app.
commute-bot: MUNI: Route 8X running 10-15 minutes behind due to traffic signal issue at 3rd/King.
Owen: I'll check lost-and-found later for my hat. Whoever rescued it will be my hero. :pray:
Harriet: Quick poll  tea or coffee at 11 for the soggy-commuters table? React :tea: or :coffee:.
Mikko: :coffee:
Rhea: :tea:
Owen: :coffee:
commute-bot: NOTE: Pier 7 volume expected to normalize by 09:30.
Mikko: Alright team, thanks for the heads-up and to whoever left the shoe covers. Stay dry out there. :umbrella:
